games.name: PUBG Mobile
games.description: Instant manual top-up for PUBG Mobile Unknown Cash (UC). Fast delivery to your Player ID within 5-15 minutes.
games.instructions:
1. Open PUBG Mobile -> Tap your profile avatar at top-right.
2. Locate your 9-11 digit numeric Character ID (e.g. 5123948291).
3. Copy and paste exactly into the Player ID field below.
4. Ensure your character name matches.

fields.label: Character / Player ID
fields.helpText: Your numerical Player ID found in your in-game profile

fields.label: In-Game Nickname (Optional)
fields.helpText: Helps us verify your account before dispatching UC

games.instructions:
1. Open Garena Free Fire -> Click your profile banner in the top-left corner.
2. Your Player UID is visible below your nickname (e.g. 2938472918).
3. Enter the numeric UID carefully.

fields.label: Player UID
fields.helpText: Your numeric Garena Free Fire UID

games.name: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang
games.description: Recharge MLBB Diamonds & Twilight Pass directly to your User ID and Zone ID. 100% safe, official Nepal payment.
games.instructions:
1. Open Mobile Legends -> Click your avatar in top-left.
2. Under your nickname you will see User ID and Zone ID in parenthesis, e.g. 12345678 (2048).
3. Enter User ID in first field and 4-5 digit Zone ID in second field.

fields.label: Zone / Server ID
fields.helpText: The 4-5 digit number in brackets next to User ID

games.name: Call of Duty Mobile

paymentMethods.name: eSewa Mobile Wallet
paymentMethods.instructions:
1. Open eSewa app on your phone.
2. Send exact NPR amount to eSewa ID: 9812345678 (GamingZone Nepal Pvt Ltd).
3. In remarks, mention your Phone or In-game name.
4. Take a screenshot of the completed transaction.
5. Copy the 16-digit Reference Code and submit below.

paymentMethods.name: Khalti Digital Wallet
paymentMethods.instructions:
1. Open Khalti App -> Send Money.
2. Enter Khalti Mobile: 9801234567.
3. Verify name "GamingZone Nepal Pvt Ltd" and send exact NPR.
4. Note down Khalti Transaction ID and take a screenshot proof.

paymentMethods.name: Fonepay QR (Any Nepal Banking App)
paymentMethods.instructions:
1. Open any Nepal Mobile Banking App (NIC Asia, Nabil, Global IME, Sanima, Everest, etc.).
2. Tap "Scan QR" and scan our Fonepay Merchant QR.
3. Confirm Merchant: GamingZone Top-Up Merchant.
4. Pay exact NPR and capture screenshot + Reference Number.

paymentMethods.name: IME Pay Wallet
paymentMethods.instructions:

2. Send to Wallet Number: 9823456789.
3. Take screenshot and copy the Transaction ID.

chatbotTriggers.reply:

• **Completed Top-ups:** Due to direct crediting of in-game currency (UC, Diamonds), once delivered to the entered ID, orders cannot be revoked.
• **Submitted Wrong ID?** WhatsApp our Kathmandu operations desk immediately at **+977 9841000001** before fulfillment begins!

chatbotTriggers.name: Delivery Speed & Operating Time
chatbotTriggers.reply:
